sol2f.gui.config.title: Spice of Life: Fabric Flavor Settings
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.Increas: Frequency of extra health increases (set to 0 to disable special rewards). Range: 0–20
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.frequen: Amount of health added to the maximum each time the frequency threshold is reached. Range: 2–30
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.healthy: Maximum health gained per unique food eaten. Range: 0–20
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.resetOn: If enabled, the player’s health resets to default upon death.
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.healthT: Fully restores health whenever the health maximum increases.
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.healthI: Restores this amount of health whenever the health maximum increases. Must be an even number.
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.Express: Custom health calculation expression (setting to 0 disables it).
Tip: To use only the expression, set base health gain and frequency gain to 0.
This setting will not affect health if disabled, even if the expression is valid. Simple health settings still apply.
- uniqueFoods: Number of unique foods consumed
- Floor: floor(num), Ceiling: ceil(num), Round: round(num)
- Minimum: min(num1, num2), Maximum: max(num1, num2)
